pr_body:
Fixes https://github.com/excalidraw/excalidraw/issues/797,

Sentry will report all uncaught exceptions directly. Also, this will modify the main error boundary to allow people to follow up on GitHub with their scene information. By default, scene information is not included on Sentry.

*If you want to test locally, just throw an error in any `render` method to trigger the error boundary.*

issue_context.title: Integrate with Sentry
issue_context.body: People are starting hitting javascript errors, would be nice to log them on the server so that we can fix them without having people to manually report them
comments:
We can't (meaning we must not) log user scene data to sentry, only stack traces, so it might still be valuable to allow people to supply them by creating an issue. Alternatively we can let users send the scene data alongside the sentry error, if they check a box.

Not sure how it'd be implemented.
